name: Kanna Urara
source:
Although she looks unhealthy, she is in good health and rarely catches colds. Her facial muscles are dying, so she's always expressionless. Her paler eye has poor vision. At home, she spends her time eating bread.

She's a freelance musician who does things such as composition and backing bands. When she has an idea, she acts on it immediately. When she has a song in mind, she writes it right away. When she wants to sing, she sings. When she wants to sleep, she sleeps. She is very sensitive and easily impressed, but it never shows on her face. She likes the time when everyone is busy doing what they like. Her stage name is "u".

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
